# BLAKE3 Assembly

This directory vendors the official BLAKE3 x86_64 assembly leaves used by the
freestanding EdgeRun BLAKE3 wrapper.

Source: https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3
Imported commit: 91f7308

The upstream project releases this code under CC0 1.0, Apache 2.0, or Apache
2.0 with LLVM exceptions. The upstream license files are kept in this
directory.
